description.value: Café Kitsuné is the café arm of the Paris-born Maison Kitsuné lifestyle brand, blending specialty coffee culture with the brand's distinctive aesthetic. The Vancouver branch sits in Gastown at 157 Water Street, placing it in one of the city's most walkable and tourist-frequented heritage neighbourhoods. It is part of an international network of cafés known for quality espresso drinks, matcha, and French-inspired patisseries.
